sharedMaterials.text: May 18 is International Day for Women in Maritime, which recognizes the importance of women in the ocean transport industry. The theme for 2025 was “An Ocean of Opportunities for Women.” In Taiwan, women represent only 4% of seafarers (航海人員). ____21____ the 260 women seafarers, many have proved that seafaring can be a rewarding career. One woman who shows the way is Huang Chao-ling (黃昭玲). Huang, who was a captain, is Taiwan’s first and only female harbor pilot. As a harbor pilot, she guides ships safely in and out of the port, which is a ____22____ job that requires taking risks, such as climbing onto a moving ship in big waves. Another front-runner is Lin Chia-ling (林嘉玲), Taiwan’s first woman oil tanker captain. Lin’s job is to ensure reliable delivery of oil to all ports in Taiwan, ____23____ the weather is terrible. Huang and Lin share a hard career path, given that women seafarers face various challenges, including insufficient onboard facilities. Today, the maritime industry is working to create a gender-friendly workplace ____24____. Such efforts are seeing results, with the number of Taiwanese women captains standing at 22 in 2024, up from 6 about ten years ago.

The Tamkang Bridge (淡江大橋) has been under construction since 2019 and is ready for use this year. It was built because the Tamsui (淡水) and Bali (八里) areas have grown quickly in recent years, and more people now commute between them. Once it opens, people can save about half an hour when traveling between the two places. Besides making ____25____ smooth, the bridge will also appeal to visitors with its special architectural style. It was designed by the world-famous architect Zaha Hadid. Being the first bridge in Taiwan ____26____ through an international design competition, the Tamkang Bridge will become the world’s longest single-tower asymmetric cable-stayed bridge (單塔不對稱斜張橋). Expressing a sense of art and beauty, the bridge’s 200-meter tower rises into the sky, ____27____ a dancer were lifting both hands in prayer. Moreover, the bridge’s shape goes well with the sunset over the Tamsui River, making the view much more eye-catching. Visitors can appreciate the riverside views here. With shorter travel time between Tamsui and Bali and its unique beauty, the Tamkang Bridge will play an important role in both ____28____. The bridge will definitely bring travel convenience and recreational benefits to the people of northern Taiwan.
